indicators.label: Major depressive episode in the past year
indicators.phrase: had a major depressive episode in the past year
indicators.definition: Had a period of at least two weeks in the past 12 months with a depressed mood or loss of interest or pleasure in daily activities, plus most of the other symptoms of depression, based on DSM criteria.

indicators.label: Major depressive episode at some point in life
indicators.phrase: have had a major depressive episode at some point in their life
indicators.definition: Ever had a period of at least two weeks with a depressed mood or loss of interest or pleasure in daily activities, plus most of the other symptoms of depression, based on DSM criteria.

indicators.label: Major depressive episode with severe impairment
indicators.phrase: had a major depressive episode with severe impairment in the past year
indicators.definition: Had a major depressive episode in the past year that severely interfered with chores at home, school or work, family relationships, or social life (Sheehan Disability Scale). The denominator is all teens.

indicators.label: Seriously thought about suicide in the past year
indicators.phrase: seriously thought about killing themselves in the past year
indicators.definition: Seriously thought about trying to kill themselves at any time in the past 12 months.
caveats: Teens who answered "I'm not sure" or "I don't want to answer" are counted as no, as in SAMHSA's published estimates.
Beginning in 2022 the teen suicide questions were moved to a different section of the interview, which may affect comparisons with 2021.

indicators.label: Made a suicide plan in the past year
indicators.phrase: made a plan to kill themselves in the past year
indicators.definition: Made any plans to kill themselves in the past 12 months.
caveats: Teens who answered "I'm not sure" or "I don't want to answer" are counted as no, as in SAMHSA's published estimates.
Beginning in 2022 the teen suicide questions were moved to a different section of the interview, which may affect comparisons with 2021.

indicators.label: Major depressive episode or substance use disorder
indicators.phrase: had a major depressive episode or a substance use disorder in the past year
indicators.definition: Had a major depressive episode in the past year, a substance use disorder in the past year (DSM-5, alcohol or drugs), or both.

indicators.label: Major depressive episode and substance use disorder
indicators.phrase: had both a major depressive episode and a substance use disorder in the past year
indicators.definition: Had a major depressive episode and a substance use disorder (DSM-5, alcohol or drugs) in the same past year.

indicators.label: Treatment or medication for depression (teens with a past-year MDE)
indicators.phrase: got treatment or medication for depression in the past year
indicators.definition: Among teens who had a major depressive episode in the past year, saw or talked to a health professional about depression or took prescription medication for it in the past 12 months.
caveats: The denominator is teens with a past-year major depressive episode.

indicators.label: Saw a professional for depression (teens with a past-year MDE)
indicators.phrase: saw or talked to a health professional about depression in the past year
indicators.definition: Among teens who had a major depressive episode in the past year, saw or talked to a medical doctor or other professional about their depression in the past 12 months.
caveats: The denominator is teens with a past-year major depressive episode.

indicators.label: Prescription medication for depression (teens with a past-year MDE)
indicators.phrase: took prescription medication for depression in the past year
indicators.definition: Among teens who had a major depressive episode in the past year, took prescription medication for depression in the past 12 months.
caveats: The denominator is teens with a past-year major depressive episode.

indicators.label: Any mental health treatment in the past year
indicators.phrase: received mental health treatment in the past year
indicators.definition: Received any mental health treatment in the past 12 months: inpatient care, outpatient care or counseling (including at school), treatment by phone or video, or prescription medication for mental health.
caveats: The mental health treatment questions were redesigned in 2022; this summary measure is available only for 2022 and 2023 in the combined file.

indicators.label: Mental health care at school
indicators.phrase: got mental health treatment or counseling at school in the past year
indicators.definition: Received mental health treatment or counseling from a school health center or school counselor in the past 12 months.
caveats: Available only for 2022 and 2023 in the combined file.

indicators.label: Mental health care by phone or video
indicators.phrase: got mental health treatment by phone or video in the past year
indicators.definition: Received mental health treatment or counseling by phone or video in the past 12 months.
caveats: Asked from 2022 on; item nonresponse is statistically imputed by SAMHSA.

indicators.label: Emergency room visit for mental health
indicators.phrase: were seen in an emergency room for mental health in the past year
indicators.definition: Were seen in an emergency room or emergency department for mental health reasons in the past 12 months.
caveats: Asked from 2022 on; item nonresponse is statistically imputed by SAMHSA.

indicators.label: Prescription medication for mental health
indicators.phrase: took prescription medication for their mental health in the past year
indicators.definition: Took prescription medication to help with emotions, nerves, or mental health in the past 12 months.
caveats: Asked from 2022 on; item nonresponse is statistically imputed by SAMHSA.

indicators.label: Alcohol use in the past month
indicators.phrase: drank alcohol in the past month
indicators.definition: Drank alcohol in the past 30 days.

indicators.label: Binge drinking in the past month
indicators.phrase: binge drank in the past month
indicators.definition: Drank five or more drinks (males) or four or more drinks (females) on the same occasion on at least one day in the past 30 days.

indicators.label: Marijuana use in the past year
indicators.phrase: used marijuana in the past year
indicators.definition: Used marijuana or hashish in the past 12 months.

indicators.label: Marijuana use in the past month
indicators.phrase: used marijuana in the past month
indicators.definition: Used marijuana or hashish in the past 30 days.

indicators.label: Nicotine vaping in the past year
indicators.phrase: vaped nicotine in the past year
indicators.definition: Vaped nicotine in the past 12 months.
caveats: Nicotine vaping questions were added in 2022.

indicators.label: Nicotine vaping in the past month
indicators.phrase: vaped nicotine in the past month
indicators.definition: Vaped nicotine in the past 30 days.
caveats: Nicotine vaping questions were added in 2022.

indicators.label: Tobacco or nicotine vaping in the past year
indicators.phrase: used tobacco or vaped nicotine in the past year
indicators.definition: Used any tobacco product (cigarettes, cigars, pipe tobacco, or smokeless tobacco) or vaped nicotine in the past 12 months.
caveats: Nicotine vaping questions were added in 2022, so this combined measure starts in 2022.

indicators.label: Illicit drug use in the past year
indicators.phrase: used an illicit drug in the past year
indicators.definition: Used marijuana, cocaine (including crack), heroin, hallucinogens, inhalants, or methamphetamine, or misused prescription pain relievers, tranquilizers, stimulants, or sedatives in the past 12 months.

indicators.label: Substance use disorder in the past year
indicators.phrase: had a substance use disorder in the past year
indicators.definition: Met DSM-5 criteria for an alcohol or drug use disorder (including marijuana) in the past 12 months.

indicators.label: Liked going to school
indicators.phrase: liked or kind of liked going to school in the past year
indicators.definition: Said they liked going to school a lot or kind of liked it during the past 12 months.
caveats: Asked only of teens who attended school in the past year.

indicators.label: Grade average of D or lower
indicators.phrase: had a grade average of D or lower in their last grading period
indicators.definition: Reported a grade average of D or lower for the last semester or grading period completed.
caveats: Asked only of teens who attended school in the past year.

indicators.label: Teachers said they were doing a good job
indicators.phrase: had a teacher tell them they were doing a good job in the past year
indicators.definition: Said a teacher let them know they were doing a good job with their schoolwork always or sometimes in the past 12 months.
caveats: Asked only of teens who attended school in the past year.

indicators.label: Parents said they were proud of them
indicators.phrase: had parents tell them they were proud of something they did in the past year
indicators.definition: Said their parents told them they were proud of something they had done always or sometimes in the past 12 months.

indicators.label: Parents checked homework
indicators.phrase: had parents check that their homework was done in the past year
indicators.definition: Said their parents checked whether their homework was done always or sometimes in the past 12 months.
caveats: Asked only of teens who attended school in the past year.

indicators.label: Parents helped with homework
indicators.phrase: had parents help with their homework in the past year
indicators.definition: Said their parents helped them with their homework always or sometimes in the past 12 months.
caveats: Asked only of teens who attended school in the past year.

indicators.label: Frequent arguments with a parent
indicators.phrase: argued or fought with a parent 10 or more times in the past year
indicators.definition: Argued or had a fight with at least one of their parents 10 or more times in the past 12 months.

indicators.label: Two or more youth activities
indicators.phrase: took part in two or more youth activities in the past year
indicators.definition: Participated in two or more kinds of activities in the past 12 months: school-based, community-based, church or faith-based, or other activities such as sports teams.

indicators.label: Religious beliefs very important
indicators.phrase: said religious beliefs are a very important part of their life
indicators.definition: Agreed or strongly agreed that their religious beliefs are a very important part of their life.

indicators.label: Serious fight at school or work
indicators.phrase: got into a serious fight at school or work in the past year
indicators.definition: Got into a serious fight at school or work one or more times in the past 12 months.

indicators.label: No one to talk to about serious problems
indicators.phrase: had no one to talk to about serious problems
indicators.definition: Said they talk to no one about serious problems (rather than a parent, boyfriend or girlfriend, another adult, or someone else).

indicators.label: Fair or poor overall health
indicators.phrase: rated their overall health as fair or poor
indicators.definition: Rated their overall health as fair or poor rather than good, very good, or excellent.

indicators.label: Serious difficulty remembering or concentrating
indicators.phrase: had a lot of difficulty remembering or concentrating
indicators.definition: Said they have a lot of difficulty remembering or concentrating, or cannot do it at all (Washington Group disability question). Some difficulty counts as no.
caveats: "Some difficulty" counts as no, following the Washington Group threshold for functional difficulty; item nonresponse is excluded.

indicators.label: Major depressive episode in the past year
indicators.phrase: had a major depressive episode in the past year
indicators.definition: Had a period of at least two weeks in the past 12 months with a depressed mood or loss of interest or pleasure in daily activities, plus most of the other symptoms of depression, based on DSM criteria.

indicators.label: Major depressive episode with severe impairment
indicators.phrase: had a major depressive episode with severe impairment in the past year
indicators.definition: Had a major depressive episode in the past year that severely interfered with home management, work, close relationships, or social life (Sheehan Disability Scale). The denominator is all young adults.

indicators.label: Seriously thought about suicide in the past year
indicators.phrase: seriously thought about killing themselves in the past year
indicators.definition: Seriously thought about trying to kill themselves at any time in the past 12 months.
caveats: Item nonresponse is statistically imputed by SAMHSA.

indicators.label: Made a suicide plan in the past year
indicators.phrase: made a plan to kill themselves in the past year
indicators.definition: Made any plans to kill themselves in the past 12 months.
caveats: Item nonresponse is statistically imputed by SAMHSA.

indicators.label: Attempted suicide in the past year
indicators.phrase: attempted suicide in the past year
indicators.definition: Tried to kill themselves in the past 12 months.
caveats: Item nonresponse is statistically imputed by SAMHSA.

indicators.label: Serious psychological distress in the past year
indicators.phrase: had serious psychological distress in the past year
indicators.definition: Scored 13 or higher on the Kessler-6 scale of psychological distress for the month in the past 12 months when they felt their worst.

indicators.label: Any mental illness in the past year
indicators.phrase: had a mental illness in the past year
indicators.definition: Had a diagnosable mental, behavioral, or emotional disorder in the past year, other than a developmental or substance use disorder, of any severity.
caveats: Estimated from a statistical model of survey scales calibrated to clinical interviews, not from a diagnosis.

indicators.label: Serious mental illness in the past year
indicators.phrase: had a serious mental illness in the past year
indicators.definition: Had a diagnosable mental, behavioral, or emotional disorder in the past year that substantially interfered with or limited one or more major life activities.
caveats: Estimated from a statistical model of survey scales calibrated to clinical interviews, not from a diagnosis.

indicators.label: Mental illness and substance use disorder
indicators.phrase: had both a mental illness and a substance use disorder in the past year
indicators.definition: Had any mental illness and a substance use disorder (DSM-5, alcohol or drugs) in the same past year.
caveats: Mental illness is estimated from a statistical model of survey scales calibrated to clinical interviews.

indicators.label: Treatment or medication for depression (young adults with a past-year MDE)
